sections.title: Guided Multi-Product Activation
description: 97% of new Chase SMB customers arrived through migration from consumer banking — users sign in to a new interface overnight, unaware of certain SMB-specific products that existed, or that their accounts deactivated within 60 days without funding, costing both the customers and Chase's business.
description2: Partnering with product, marketing, finance, and engineering teams, I designed onboarding, driving SMB customers to adopt products that were valuable to them and led to higher revenue for Chase — driving product activation and increased fraud protection enrollment.

sections.title: Chase Travel Redesign
description: Chase Travel's homepage was built for exploration, but most visitors arrived with a destination already in mind, exploring in Expedia, Google Flights, etc. Most of the page was discovery content — yet it drove under 0.01% engagement, and 90% of customers said in testing they didn't want it.
description2: Working with product and marketing, I redesigned the homepage around value: a hero leading with rewards and redemption, personalized to each customer's card. The redesign also showed the full breadth of what Chase offered — connecting every offering back to the card rewards at the center of Chase Travel's value prop.

sections.title: Dining Loyalty, from Scratch.
description: Chase had no dining loyalty program, even as competitors offered cardholders dedicated dining perks and discovery tools. Sapphire Reserve holders already had a $300 annual dining credit sitting largely unused, with nothing built to help them find where to spend it — a gap the Sapphire team wanted closed, with reservations handled through a network partner rather than built in-house.
description2: As sole product designer, I mapped an 18-month vision — rich visuals, ratings, and content pulled from partners like Infatuation — then shipped a lean MVP to test demand, connecting Sapphire holders to exclusive, cardholder-only tables through OpenTable. It became the second-most-used Sapphire Reserve benefit within four months.
